claim: A Local Zone brings only the core services that the latency-sensitive part of a workload needs closer to end users, while an Availability Zone gives access to the full set of AWS services.
question: FAQ: How are Local Zones different from Availability Zones?

values.display: the core services needed for the latency-sensitive portions of your workload
values.spoken: a Local Zone carries only the core services for the latency-sensitive part of a workload

values.display: Availability Zones provide access to the full array of AWS services

evidence.quote: Local Zones are designed to bring the core services needed for the latency-sensitive portions of your workload closer to end users, while Availability Zones provide access to the full array of AWS services.
